lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible vertical columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the branchial region, forming a grid-like lattice with approximately 4-5 spots per vertical column in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of pale-to-mid intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured nodal pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-7 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs are visible within the lower two-thirds of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency clustering of smaller spots on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit and on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
